data.name: Snow Sugar Cookie
data.description:
Snow Sugar Cookie is a timid youth who loves snowball fights and making friends. He wields a magic snow wand which summons their best friend, Snow King. They play a major protagonist role in Icicle Yeti's Winter Song as the titular Icicle Yeti Cookie Yeti's newest friend.

Made of snow, sugar, ice, and an unknown secret ingredient, this Cookie was once very lonely, wandering through a vast snowy field. Then one day, Snow Sugar Cookie found a magic wand that could summon snow creatures and wouldn't melt even in the oven. The Cookie quickly learned to summon friends like the Sea Snow Cone and the Great Snow King and was never lonely again.

Snow Sugar Cookie is a young, round Cookie with medium-tone dough. He has short white hair with bangs defined with pale blue. His earmuffs are striped with white and cool blue with purple sprinkles on each side, resembling meringue dollops. He wears a long-sleeved baby blue winter coat with white lining, fitted black pants, and white gloves with blue accents.

Snow Sugar Cookie's name is based on snow sugar, a powdery sugar that doesn't melt when baked. It is also perhaps a play on "sugar cookie".
